p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ta.avg_standard_attr_id) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpHighWindowedAvgPorts AS a WHERE a.PORT_ID IN (SELECT d.port_id FROM DownPortsHighStdAttrInSecurityGroups AS d) ORDER BY a.NETWORK_ID, a.PORT_ID

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.STATUS AS port_status, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c') SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.port_status, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.ID = inner_cte.port_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > (SELECT AVG(p3.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) FROM `ports` AS p3 WHERE p3.NETWORK_ID = p2.NETWORK_ID)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), PortSecurityRollup AS (SELECT p.status, CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS port_security_status, COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON inner_cte.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status, port_security_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_security_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_security_status END AS port_security_status, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports FROM PortSecurityRollup GROUP BY status, port_security_status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q1.port_id, q1.port_status, q1.ip_address, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_in_network, q2.port_security_status, q2.total_ports FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.status = q1.port_status ORDER BY q1.port_id

WITH networks_mtu_detail AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a), ports_sg_ranked AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), SecurityGroupAverages AS (SELECT AVG(sg_port_count) AS avg_ports_per_sg FROM (SELECT sgpb2.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_port_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb2 JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON sgpb2.port_id = p2.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id GROUP BY sgpb2.security_group_id) AS sg_counts) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT sgpb3.security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_in_sg FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb3 JOIN `ports` AS p3 ON sgpb3.port_id = p3.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb3 ON p3.id = psb3.port_id GROUP BY sgpb3.security_group_id) AS sg_totals ON sg_totals.security_group_id = i.security_group_id WHERE sg_totals.total_ports_in_sg > (SELECT avg_ports_per_sg FROM SecurityGroupAverages)) SELECT nmd.network_id, nmd.network_name, nmd.tenant_id, nmd.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, nmd.mtu, nmd.standard_attr_updated_at AS network_standard_attr_updated_at, nmd.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, nmd.deviation_from_avg_mtu, psr.port_id, psr.mac_address, psr.security_group_id, psr.window_column AS port_rank_within_security_group FROM networks_mtu_detail AS nmd JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.network_id = nmd.network_id AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') JOIN ports_sg_ranked AS psr ON psr.port_id = p.id AND psr.tenant_id = p.tenant_id ORDER BY nmd.network_name, psr.security_group_id, psr.port_id

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.port_status AND p.device_owner = i.device_owner JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports' AND NOT p.network_id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM `ports` AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id WHERE p2.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC) SELECT i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.status LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev ORDER BY i.binding_count_range DESC) SELECT q1.port_status, q1.device_owner, q1.port_count, q1.earliest_standard_attr_update, q1.has_floating_ips AS top10_combo_has_floating_ips, q2.binding_count_range, q2.binding_count_variance, q2.binding_count_stddev, q2.has_floating_ips AS tenant_ports_in_status_have_floating_ips FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.status = q1.port_status ORDER BY q1.port_count DESC

WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, b.HOST AS host, b.VIF_TYPE AS vif_type, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN') SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.host, inner_cte.vif_type, inner_cte.ip_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports, avg_down.avg_down_port_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(port_id) AS total_down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS down_port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_down ON 1 = 1), top_tenants_admin_up AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT i.port_id) AS total_ports, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS total_ip_allocations, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = i.port_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ip_allocations DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT dp.port_id, dp.tenant_id, dp.host, dp.vif_type, dp.ip_address, dp.window_column, dp.total_down_ports, dp.avg_down_port_count, tt.total_ports AS admin_up_total_ports, tt.total_ip_allocations AS admin_up_total_ip_allocations, tt.has_floating_ips FROM down_ports AS dp JOIN top_tenants_admin_up AS tt ON dp.tenant_id = tt.tenant_id

WITH SubnetRouteStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN (SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM `subnetroutes` AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC), SubnetTenantStats AS (SELECT s.tenant_id, i.subnet_name, i.route_count_range, i.route_count_variance, i.route_count_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name AND s.ip_version = 4 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(subnet_name) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, AVG(route_count_range) AS avg_route_count_range, AVG(route_count_variance) AS avg_route_count_variance, AVG(route_count_stddev) AS avg_route_count_stddev FROM SubnetTenantStats GROUP BY tenant_id, subnet_name WITH ROLLUP), PortStatusOwnerStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_status) OVER (ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) = port_status THEN NULL ELSE port_status END AS port_status, device_owner, port_count, earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.device_owner) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE i.device_owner END AS device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_status_sort, port_status, device_owner) SELECT srs.tenant_id, srs.subnet_name, srs.avg_route_count_range, srs.avg_route_count_variance, srs.avg_route_count_stddev, pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM SubnetRouteStats AS srs CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats AS pso

WITH DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeAverages AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeAverages AS v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM AdminUpPortsAboveVifTypeWindowAvg AS a WHERE a.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') AND a.PORT_ID IN (SELECT port_id FROM DownPortsAboveAvgRunningSum) ORDER BY a.NETWORK_ID, a.PORT_ID

WITH AdminUpPortSecurityRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, binding_count, port_security_enabled_total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, MAX(i.tenant_id) AS tenant_id, MAX(i.mac_address) AS mac_address, SUM(i.binding_count) AS binding_count, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_total) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort), DownPortsWindowedStandardAttrSum AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000) SELECT a.port_id, a.tenant_id, a.mac_address, a.binding_count, a.port_security_enabled_total, d.window_column AS down_ports_running_standard_attr_id_sum_gt_1000 FROM AdminUpPortSecurityRollup AS a LEFT JOIN DownPortsWindowedStandardAttrSum AS d ON a.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND a.mac_address = d.mac_address ORDER BY a.port_id

WITH SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')), AvgStdAttr AS (SELECT AVG(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.rbac_target_tenant, i.window_column, (s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID - a.avg_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr CROSS JOIN AvgStdAttr AS a), SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = i.subnet_name WHERE i.coefficient_of_variation > (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT s1.subnet_name, s1.subnet_cidr, s1.rbac_target_tenant, s1.window_column, s1.deviation_from_avg_standard_attr_id, s2.coefficient_of_variation FROM SubnetRbacWindowAndDeviation AS s1 JOIN SubnetDnsCvAboveAvg AS s2 ON s2.subnet_name = s1.subnet_name WHERE s1.rbac_target_tenant IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b') ORDER BY s2.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH q1_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')), q1_avg_window AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM q1_inner_cte), q1 AS (SELECT i.NAME, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_min FROM q1_inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN q1_avg_window AS a), q2_inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), q2 AS (SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(port_id) OVER (ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) = port_id THEN NULL ELSE port_id END AS port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, ip_allocation_count, subnet_id_rows FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.port_id END AS port_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.port_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.mac_address END AS mac_address, SUM(i.ip_allocation_count) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(i.subnet_id_rows) AS subnet_id_rows FROM q2_inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY port_id_sort, port_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS Down_Ports_In_Network_With_SG_Bindings, AVG(q1.deviation_from_avg_window_min) AS Avg_Deviation_From_Avg_Window_Min_Admin_State_Up, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.ip_allocation_count END) AS Total_Ip_Allocations_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant, MAX(CASE WHEN q2.port_id = 'TOTAL' THEN q2.subnet_id_rows END) AS Total_Subnet_Id_Rows_For_Admin_Up_Ports_In_Tenant FROM q1 CROSS JOIN q2

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT subnet_name, order_range, order_variance FROM inner_cte WHERE order_range > (SELECT AVG(order_range) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY order_range DESC), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC) SELECT q1.subnet_name, q1.order_range, q1.order_variance, q2.coefficient_of_variation, q2.deviation_from_avg FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.subnet_name ORDER BY q1.order_range DESC, q2.deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH network_mtu_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), AverageMtu AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.network_id, ic.network_name, ic.tenant_id, ic.admin_state_up, ic.mtu, ic.standard_attr_updated_at, ic.window_column, am.avg_mtu AS benchmark_mtu, CASE WHEN ic.mtu > am.avg_mtu * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_MTU' WHEN ic.mtu < am.avg_mtu * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_MTU' ELSE 'AVERAGE_MTU' END AS mtu_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageMtu AS am), port_vif_details AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeCounts AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE), AverageVifTypePorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM VifTypeCounts) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, vtc.total_ports, avp.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN vtc.total_ports > avp.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN vtc.total_ports < avp.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeCounts AS vtc ON i.VIF_TYPE = vtc.VIF_TYPE CROSS JOIN AverageVifTypePorts AS avp) SELECT nmd.network_id, nmd.network_name, nmd.tenant_id, nmd.admin_state_up, nmd.mtu, nmd.standard_attr_updated_at, nmd.window_column AS network_row_number_within_tenant, nmd.benchmark_mtu, nmd.mtu_category, pvd.PORT_ID, pvd.HOST, pvd.VIF_TYPE, pvd.VNIC_TYPE, pvd.MAC_ADDRESS, pvd.STATUS AS port_status, pvd.DEVICE_OWNER, pvd.window_column AS port_std_attr_id_window_avg, pvd.total_ports AS total_ports_for_vif_type, pvd.benchmark AS avg_ports_per_vif_type_benchmark, pvd.user_category AS vif_type_user_category FROM network_mtu_details AS nmd JOIN port_vif_details AS pvd ON pvd.NETWORK_ID = nmd.network_id AND pvd.TENANT_ID = nmd.tenant_id WHERE nmd.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')

WITH PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address), TenantAverages AS (SELECT tenant_id, AVG(ip_allocation_count) AS avg_ip_allocs FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TenantAverages AS ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE i.ip_allocation_count > ta.avg_ip_allocs), ActiveNetworksWithTenantRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name), TotalPortsAboveAvg AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_ports_above_avg FROM PortAllocationsAboveTenantAvg) SELECT tpa.total_ports_above_avg, anwr.total_networks, ROUND(tpa.total_ports_above_avg / NULLIF(anwr.total_networks, 0), 2) AS avg_ports_above_avg_per_active_network FROM TotalPortsAboveAvg AS tpa CROSS JOIN (SELECT total_networks FROM ActiveNetworksWithTenantRollup WHERE tenant_id = 'TOTAL') AS anwr

WITH down_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)), admin_up_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), VifTypeAverages AS (SELECT VIF_TYPE, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY VIF_TYPE) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN VifTypeAverages AS v ON v.VIF_TYPE = i.VIF_TYPE WHERE i.window_column > v.avg_window_column) SELECT a.PORT_ID, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, d.window_column AS down_running_sum_standard_attr_id FROM admin_up_ports AS a JOIN down_ports AS d ON d.port_id = a.PORT_ID ORDER BY a.window_column DESC, d.window_column DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows ORDER BY i.ip_allocation_count DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.tenant_id, inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) SELECT s1.port_id, s1.tenant_id AS tenant_id_admin_up_top_ip_allocations, s1.mac_address, s1.ip_allocation_count, s1.subnet_id_rows, s1.has_floating_ips AS port_has_floating_ips, s2.tenant_id AS tenant_id_down_ports_port_security_enabled, s2.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, s2.has_floating_ips AS down_ports_have_any_floating_ips FROM subq1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN subq2 AS s2

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActionExternalSummary AS (SELECT i.action, CASE WHEN NOT en.network_id IS NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY i.action, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(action) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE action END AS action, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(action) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM ActionExternalSummary GROUP BY action, external_status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance, STDDEV(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_stddev FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, avg_ip_version, ip_version_variance, ip_version_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, AVG(i.avg_ip_version) AS avg_ip_version, AVG(i.ip_version_variance) AS ip_version_variance, AVG(i.ip_version_stddev) AS ip_version_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.action WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort) SELECT q1.action, q1.external_status, q1.total_rows, q2.avg_ip_version, q2.ip_version_variance, q2.ip_version_stddev, ROUND(q1.total_rows / NULLIF(SUM(q1.total_rows) OVER (PARTITION BY q1.action), 0), 4) AS pct_of_action_total FROM q1 LEFT JOIN q2 ON q2.action = q1.action ORDER BY CASE WHEN q1.action = 'GRAND TOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.action, CASE WHEN q1.external_status = 'SUBTOTAL' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, q1.external_status

WITH ps_rollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')), PortSecurityStatus AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, CASE WHEN psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS port_security_state, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS total_ports FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, port_security_state) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE port_status END AS port_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(port_security_state) = 1 AND GROUPING(port_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE port_security_state END AS port_security_state, SUM(total_ports) AS total_ports, MAX(inner_cte.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM PortSecurityStatus CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY port_status, port_security_state WITH ROLLUP), volume_by_owner AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a) SELECT v.port_status, v.device_owner, v.port_count, v.earliest_standard_attr_update, v.benchmark, v.volume_category, p.total_ports AS tenant17_total_ports_with_port_security_binding, p.down_ports_with_port_security_enabled AS tenant17_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM volume_by_owner AS v LEFT JOIN ps_rollup AS p ON p.port_status = v.port_status AND p.port_security_state = 'SUBTOTAL' ORDER BY v.port_status, v.port_count DESC, v.device_owner

WITH rbac_action_subnet_ip_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ACTION, VARIANCE(s.IP_VERSION) AS ip_version_variance FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY n.ACTION ORDER BY ip_version_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(action) OVER (ORDER BY action_sort, action) = action THEN NULL ELSE action END AS action, ip_version_variance, distinct_subnets FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.action END AS action_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.action) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.action END AS action, i.ip_version_variance AS ip_version_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.id) AS distinct_subnets FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n2 ON n2.action = i.action AND n2.action = 'access_as_shared' AND n2.target_tenant = '*' JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.network_id = n2.object_id GROUP BY i.action, i.ip_version_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY action_sort, action), network_status_security_binding_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_status) OVER (ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status) = network_status THEN NULL ELSE network_status END AS network_status, networks_count, port_security_enabled_variance, port_security_enabled_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS networks_count, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.network_status = n.STATUS WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status) SELECT r.action, r.ip_version_variance, r.distinct_subnets, n.network_status, n.networks_count, n.port_security_enabled_variance, n.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM rbac_action_subnet_ip_stats AS r CROSS JOIN network_status_security_binding_stats AS n

WITH networks_subq AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - WITH PortDnsAndSg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), ActiveNetworksMtu AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a) SELECT an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu, COUNT(DISTINCT pds.port_id) AS admin_up_sg_bound_port_count, AVG(pds.dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records_per_port, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'HIGH_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'LOW_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_dns_port_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pds.dns_category = 'AVERAGE_DNS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS average_dns_port_count FROM ActiveNetworksMtu AS an JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.network_id = an.network_id AND p.tenant_id = an.tenant_id AND p.admin_state_up = 1 JOIN PortDnsAndSg AS pds ON pds.port_id = p.id AND pds.tenant_id = an.tenant_id GROUP BY an.network_id, an.network_name, an.tenant_id, an.admin_state_up, an.mtu, an.standard_attr_updated_at, an.window_column, an.deviation_from_avg_mtu ORDER BY an.tenant_id, an.network_name

`standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) = tenant_id THEN NULL ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column, total_networks FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(tenant_id) OVER (ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE network_name END AS network_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE admin_state_up END AS admin_state_up, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE mtu END AS mtu, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE standard_attr_updated_at END AS standard_attr_updated_at, CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE window_column END AS window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id, network_id, network_name, admin_state_up, mtu, standard_attr_updated_at, window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY tenant_id_sort, tenant_id, network_name) SELECT (SELECT SUM(binding_count) FROM port_security_by_port WHERE port_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_port_security_bindings_for_admin_up_ports, (SELECT SUM(port_security_enabled_total) FROM port_security_by_port WHERE port_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_port_security_enabled_across_bindings, (SELECT MAX(total_networks) FROM active_networks_by_tenant WHERE tenant_id = 'TOTAL') AS total_active_networks_for_tenant FROM (SELECT 1 AS dummy) AS d

WITH sg_admin_up_ports AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_sg_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), sg_down_ports_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, sgpb.security_group_id, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.id) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'), sg_counts AS (SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS down_ports FROM inner_cte GROUP BY security_group_id) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, c.down_ports FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN sg_counts AS c ON i.security_group_id = c.security_group_id WHERE c.down_ports > (SELECT AVG(down_ports) FROM sg_counts)) SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.port_id) AS admin_up_ports_with_sg_bindings_count, COUNT(DISTINCT d.port_id) AS down_ports_in_security_groups_above_avg_count FROM sg_admin_up_ports AS a CROSS JOIN sg_down_ports_above_avg AS d

WITH sg_admin_ports_above_avg AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM inner_cte WHERE security_group_binding_count > (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) FROM inner_cte)), down_ports_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT inner_cte.port_id, inner_cte.tenant_id, inner_cte.mac_address, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_down_ports_for_tenant, avg_counts.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT p.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_for_tenant FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.tenant_id = tenant_counts.tenant_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM (SELECT COUNT(p.id) AS port_count FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' GROUP BY p.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT s.port_id, s.tenant_id, s.port_name, s.security_group_binding_count, s.dns_record_count, d.mac_address, d.window_column, d.total_down_ports_for_tenant, d.avg_down_ports_across_tenants FROM sg_admin_ports_above_avg AS s JOIN down_ports_window_stats AS d ON s.port_id = d.port_id AND s.tenant_id = d.tenant_id

WITH TenantPortSummary AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS total_ports, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT inner_cte.security_group_id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_security_groups FROM `ports` AS p LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON p.network_id = inner_cte.network_id AND p.mac_address = inner_cte.mac_address GROUP BY p.tenant_id ORDER BY total_ports DESC LIMIT 10), TenantDownPortWindowed AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), TenantAvg AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p2 ON p2.ID = i.port_id JOIN TenantAvg AS ta ON ta.tenant_id = i.tenant_id WHERE p2.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > ta.avg_standard_attr_id), TenantDownPortCounts AS (SELECT p.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS down_ports_in_network FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.network_id IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d') GROUP BY p.tenant_id) SELECT tps.tenant_id, tps.total_ports, tps.has_security_groups, tdc.down_ports_in_network, COUNT(DISTINCT tdpw.port_id) AS qualifying_down_ports_for_tenant_98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57 FROM TenantPortSummary AS tps JOIN TenantDownPortCounts AS tdc ON tps.tenant_id = tdc.tenant_id LEFT JOIN TenantDownPortWindowed AS tdpw ON tps.tenant_id = tdpw.tenant_id WHERE (tdc.down_ports_in_network * 1.0 / NULLIF(tps.total_ports, 0)) > 0.75 GROUP BY tps.tenant_id, tps.total_ports, tps.has_security_groups, tdc.down_ports_in_network ORDER BY tps.total_ports DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, SUM(sa.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY sa.RESOURCE_TYPE ORDER BY sa.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7')) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 1000), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_id) OVER (ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) = network_id THEN NULL ELSE network_id END AS network_id, name, mac_address, admin_state_up, status, device_owner, security_group_id, window_column, total_ports FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_id) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.network_id END AS network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_ports FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.network_id, i.name, i.mac_address, i.admin_state_up, i.status, i.device_owner, i.security_group_id, i.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_id_sort, network_id, name, mac_address, security_group_id) SELECT q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.admin_state_up, q2.status, q2.device_owner, q2.security_group_id, q2.window_column AS min_admin_state_window, q2.total_ports, q1.port_id, q1.tenant_id, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_ids FROM q2 LEFT JOIN q1 ON q1.mac_address = q2.mac_address ORDER BY q2.network_id, q2.name, q2.mac_address, q2.security_group_id

WITH sq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID) = inner_cte.NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.NAME END AS name, inner_cte.window_column, r.TENANT_ID AS rbac_tenant_id, r.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = n.ID AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME, r.TENANT_ID), sq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), tenant_counts AS (SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matching_networks FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') AS totals ON 1 = 1 JOIN avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT sq1.name, sq1.window_column, sq1.rbac_tenant_id, sq1.rbac_target_tenant, sq2.total_matching_networks, sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, ROUND(sq2.total_matching_networks / NULLIF(sq2.avg_networks_per_tenant, 0), 2) AS total_to_avg_ratio FROM sq1 JOIN sq2 ON sq2.NAME = sq1.name AND sq2.window_column = sq1.window_column ORDER BY sq1.name, sq1.rbac_tenant_id

WITH TopTenantsExternalAccess AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10), TenantStatusRollup AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT t.tenant_id, t.total_qualifying_networks, t.has_targeted_rbac, r.status, r.total_networks FROM TopTenantsExternalAccess AS t JOIN TenantStatusRollup AS r ON r.tenant_id = t.tenant_id WHERE r.status <> 'SUBTOTAL' AND r.tenant_id <> 'GRAND TOTAL' ORDER BY t.total_qualifying_networks DESC, r.status

WITH port_dns_security AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), AverageDns AS (SELECT AVG(dns_record_count) AS avg_dns_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.port_id, ic.tenant_id, ic.port_name, ic.security_group_binding_count, ic.dns_record_count, ad.avg_dns_records AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.dns_record_count > ad.avg_dns_records * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_DNS' WHEN ic.dns_record_count < ad.avg_dns_records * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_DNS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_DNS' END AS dns_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageDns AS ad), active_network_mtu AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), avg_mtu_cte AS (SELECT AVG(mtu) AS avg_mtu FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.network_name, i.tenant_id, i.admin_state_up, i.mtu, i.standard_attr_updated_at, i.window_column, (i.mtu - a.avg_mtu) AS deviation_from_avg_mtu FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_mtu_cte AS a), port_network_bridge AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.network_id FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')) SELECT anm.network_id, anm.network_name, anm.tenant_id, anm.admin_state_up AS network_admin_state_up, anm.mtu, anm.standard_attr_updated_at, anm.window_column, anm.deviation_from_avg_mtu, pds.port_id, pds.port_name, pds.security_group_binding_count, pds.dns_record_count, pds.benchmark AS avg_dns_records_benchmark, pds.dns_category FROM active_network_mtu AS anm JOIN port_network_bridge AS pnb ON pnb.network_id = anm.network_id JOIN port_dns_security AS pds ON pds.port_id = pnb.port_id WHERE anm.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, a.avg_port_count AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_count > a.avg_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VOLUME' WHEN i.port_count < a.avg_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VOLUME' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VOLUME' END AS volume_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), TenantPortCounts AS (SELECT p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p.ID) AS tenant_port_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.TENANT_ID) SELECT q1.tenant_id, q1.status AS network_status, q1.total_networks, tpc.tenant_port_count, ROUND(tpc.tenant_port_count / NULLIF(q1.total_networks, 0), 2) AS ports_per_default_external_network, q2.port_status, q2.device_owner, q2.port_count, q2.benchmark, q2.volume_category, q2.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM q1 JOIN TenantPortCounts AS tpc ON tpc.tenant_id = q1.tenant_id CROSS JOIN q2 WHERE NOT q1.tenant_id IN ('GRAND TOTAL', 'SUBTOTAL') ORDER BY ports_per_default_external_network DESC, q1.tenant_id, q1.status, q2.port_count DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP) SELECT q2.tenant_id, q2.status, q2.total_networks AS total_default_external_networks, q1.total_networks_with_security_binding, q1.port_security_enabled_variance, q1.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM q2 JOIN q1 ON q2.status = q1.network_status WHERE NOT q2.tenant_id IN ('GRAND TOTAL') AND NOT q2.status IN ('SUBTOTAL') AND q1.total_networks_with_security_binding > 0 ORDER BY q2.total_networks DESC, q2.tenant_id, q2.status

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT inner_cte.loadbalancer_name, inner_cte.vip_address, inner_cte.bytes_in, inner_cte.total_connections, inner_cte.window_column, lb.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, tenant_counts.haproxy_lb_count AS tenant_haproxy_loadbalancer_count, avg_counts.avg_haproxy_lb_count AS avg_haproxy_loadbalancers_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.vip_address JOIN (SELECT lb2.TENANT_ID, COUNT(lb2.ID) AS haproxy_lb_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra2.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb2.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_counts ON tenant_counts.TENANT_ID = lb.TENANT_ID JOIN (SELECT AVG(sub.haproxy_lb_count) AS avg_haproxy_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb3.TENANT_ID, COUNT(lb3.ID) AS haproxy_lb_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb3 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra3 ON lb3.ID = pra3.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra3.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb3.TENANT_ID) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_shared_rbac_networks FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_shared_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_specific_target_tenant_share FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_active_shared_networks DESC LIMIT 10

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_haproxy_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.ID) AS total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, inner_cte.online_haproxy_loadbalancers AS overall_online_haproxy_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID, inner_cte.online_haproxy_loadbalancers ORDER BY total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT inner_cte.loadbalancer_name, inner_cte.vip_address, inner_cte.bytes_in, inner_cte.total_connections, inner_cte.window_column, lb.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, tenant_counts.haproxy_lb_count AS tenant_haproxy_loadbalancer_count, avg_counts.avg_haproxy_lb_count AS avg_haproxy_loadbalancers_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.vip_address JOIN (SELECT lb2.TENANT_ID, COUNT(lb2.ID) AS haproxy_lb_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra2.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb2.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_counts ON tenant_counts.TENANT_ID = lb.TENANT_ID JOIN (SELECT AVG(sub.haproxy_lb_count) AS avg_haproxy_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb3.TENANT_ID, COUNT(lb3.ID) AS haproxy_lb_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb3 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra3 ON lb3.ID = pra3.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra3.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb3.TENANT_ID) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT q1.TENANT_ID, q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q1.overall_online_haproxy_loadbalancers, q2.loadbalancer_name, q2.vip_address, q2.bytes_in, q2.total_connections, q2.window_column, q2.tenant_haproxy_loadbalancer_count, q2.avg_haproxy_loadbalancers_per_tenant FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q2.tenant_id = q1.TENANT_ID ORDER BY q1.total_online_haproxy_loadbalancers DESC, q2.loadbalancer_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.network_status, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev, avg_vars.avg_variance_across_statuses FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance_across_statuses FROM inner_cte) AS avg_vars ORDER BY inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS ip_allocation_pool_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = inner_cte.subnet_name JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation > 0.5 GROUP BY inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY inner_cte.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(OPERATING_STATUS) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE OPERATING_STATUS END AS OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(total_bytes_in) AS total_bytes_in FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OPERATING_STATUS WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS online_haproxy_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), TenantCounts AS (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' AND pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID), AvgTenantCount AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_online_haproxy_count) AS avg_tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM TenantCounts) SELECT tc.TENANT_ID, tc.tenant_online_haproxy_count FROM TenantCounts AS tc CROSS JOIN inner_cte CROSS JOIN AvgTenantCount AS atc WHERE tc.tenant_online_haproxy_count > atc.avg_tenant_online_haproxy_count

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1), HostStatusCounts AS (SELECT status, host, COUNT(*) AS total_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY status, host) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(host) = 1 AND GROUPING(status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE host END AS host, SUM(total_groups) AS total_groups FROM HostStatusCounts GROUP BY status, host WITH ROLLUP

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.status JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT p.tenant_id, STDDEV(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) / NULLIF(AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)), 0) AS tenant_coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_active_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DOWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_down_ports, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'BUILD' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_build_ports FROM `portsecuritybindings` AS psb JOIN `ports` AS p ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.id = ia.port_id JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.status = p.status WHERE psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id HAVING AVG(LENGTH(ia.ip_address)) > 0 ORDER BY tenant_coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT s1.status, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.has_floating_ips, COUNT(DISTINCT s2.tenant_id) AS top_tenants_with_ports_in_that_status FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = s1.status JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s2.tenant_id = p.tenant_id GROUP BY s1.status, s1.coefficient_of_variation, s1.has_floating_ips ORDER BY s1.coefficient_of_variation DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), NetworkRbacCounts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(r.id) AS total_rbacs FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkRbacCounts AS c ON c.network_id = n.id WHERE c.total_rbacs > (SELECT AVG(total_rbacs) FROM NetworkRbacCounts)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, lb_name, lb_id, vip_address, provisioning_status, operating_status, window_column FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(pra.PROVIDER_NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE pra.PROVIDER_NAME END AS provider_name, inner_cte.NAME AS lb_name, inner_cte.ID AS lb_id, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, inner_cte.window_column AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON inner_cte.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.ID, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.PROVISIONING_STATUS, inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS, inner_cte.window_column WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, lb_name

WITH down_secure_ports_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_port_security_enabled FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND psb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED = 1) SELECT p.tenant_id AS ports_tenant_id, COUNT(p.id) AS total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id JOIN (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_down_secure_port_count FROM (SELECT p2.tenant_id, COUNT(p2.id) AS port_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb2 ON p2.id = psb2.port_id WHERE p2.status = 'DOWN' AND psb2.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p2.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 CROSS JOIN inner_cte WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND psb.port_security_enabled = 1 GROUP BY p.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_down_secure_port_count), sg_admin_up_ports_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id,
