p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, SUM(inner_cte.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(inner_cte.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count) SELECT ds.ports_tenant_id AS tenant_id, ds.total_down_ports_with_port_security_enabled, ds.avg_down_secure_port_count, sa.total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, sa.total_security_group_bindings, sa.total_dns_records, sa.avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant FROM down_secure_ports_by_tenant AS ds JOIN sg_admin_up_ports_by_tenant AS sa ON sa.tenant_id = ds.ports_tenant_id

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(provider_name) OVER (ORDER BY provider_name_sort, provider_name, total_connections, loadbalancer_id) = provider_name THEN NULL ELSE provider_name END AS provider_name, loadbalancer_id, loadbalancer_name, vip_address, total_connections, total_online_loadbalancers FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.provider_name END AS provider_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.provider_name END AS provider_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.loadbalancer_id END AS loadbalancer_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.loadbalancer_name END AS loadbalancer_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.provider_name) = 1 THEN NULL ELSE i.vip_address END AS vip_address, SUM(i.window_column) AS total_connections, COUNT(i.loadbalancer_id) AS total_online_loadbalancers FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.provider_name, i.loadbalancer_id, i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY provider_name_sort, provider_name, total_connections, loadbalancer_id

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), ProviderAverages AS (SELECT pra.PROVIDER_NAME, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME) SELECT i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address, i.bytes_in, i.total_connections, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON lb2.NAME = i.loadbalancer_name AND lb2.VIP_ADDRESS = i.vip_address JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE i.total_connections > (SELECT avg_total_connections FROM ProviderAverages WHERE ProviderAverages.PROVIDER_NAME = pra2.PROVIDER_NAME) ORDER BY i.loadbalancer_name

WITH port_sg_dns_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_sg_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), tenant_active_network_latest_update AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.ID AS network_id, n.NAME AS network_name, n.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP AS admin_state_up, n.MTU AS mtu, sa.UPDATED_AT AS standard_attr_updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') SELECT tenant_id, MAX(standard_attr_updated_at) AS latest_standard_attr_updated_at FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) SELECT psdd.tenant_id, tanlu.latest_standard_attr_updated_at, COUNT(DISTINCT psdd.port_id) AS port_count, AVG(psdd.security_group_binding_count) AS avg_security_group_binding_count_per_port, SUM(psdd.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_record_count_across_ports, AVG(psdd.deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count) AS avg_deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM port_sg_dns_deviation AS psdd JOIN tenant_active_network_latest_update AS tanlu ON psdd.tenant_id = tanlu.tenant_id GROUP BY psdd.tenant_id, tanlu.latest_standard_attr_updated_at ORDER BY port_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.status, STDDEV(p.standard_attr_id) / NULLIF(AVG(p.standard_attr_id), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id GROUP BY p.status HAVING AVG(p.standard_attr_id) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC) SELECT i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.status JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON f.fixed_port_id = p.id GROUP BY i.status, i.coefficient_of_variation ORDER BY i.coefficient_of_variation DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > (SELECT AVG(window_column) FROM inner_cte)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT p2.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_pool_ending_at_gateway FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.NAME = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID AND p2.LAST_IP = s2.GATEWAY_IP GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance ORDER BY i.first_ip_range DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.STATUS = i.network_status JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) >= 3 ORDER BY i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_action FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(action_count) AS avg_networks_per_action FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS action_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY window_column) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1 GROUP BY inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_action

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS total_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_loadbalancers FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_haproxy_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra2.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') AS totals ON 1 = 1 WHERE (i.total_loadbalancers * 1.0 / totals.total_haproxy_loadbalancers) > 0.50

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT inner_cte.tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.port_id) AS total_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up, SUM(inner_cte.security_group_binding_count) AS total_security_group_bindings, SUM(inner_cte.dns_record_count) AS total_dns_records, avg_ports.avg_port_count AS avg_ports_with_sg_binding_admin_up_per_tenant FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(port_id) AS port_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_ports GROUP BY inner_cte.tenant_id, avg_ports.avg_port_count

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10

WITH SubnetDetails AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2), TopSharedNetworks AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3), AvgTop3 AS (SELECT AVG(subnet_count) AS avg_subnet_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.TARGET_TENANT) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.OBJECT_ID = i.network_id AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY i.network_id, i.subnet_count HAVING i.subnet_count > (SELECT avg_subnet_count FROM AvgTop3) ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT sd.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, sd.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, sd.CIDR AS cidr, sd.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, sd.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, sd.FIRST_IP AS first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 AS max_standard_attr_id_next2, tsn.subnet_count AS shared_network_subnet_count, tsn.distinct_target_tenants AS shared_network_distinct_target_tenants FROM SubnetDetails AS sd JOIN TopSharedNetworks AS tsn ON tsn.network_id = sd.NETWORK_ID) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY network_id, subnet_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), TenantPorts AS (SELECT p2.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(p2.ID) AS total_ports FROM `ports` AS p2 GROUP BY p2.TENANT_ID), AveragePorts AS (SELECT AVG(total_ports) AS avg_ports FROM TenantPorts) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, tp.total_ports, ap.avg_ports AS benchmark, CASE WHEN tp.total_ports > ap.avg_ports * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER' WHEN tp.total_ports < ap.avg_ports * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS user_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.ID = i.port_id JOIN TenantPorts AS tp ON tp.tenant_id = p.TENANT_ID CROSS JOIN AveragePorts AS ap ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) SELECT allowed_mac_address, allowed_ip_address, port_id, security_group_id, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 0 ORDER BY allowed_ip_address

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS total_loadbalancers FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_loadbalancers) AS avg_loadbalancers FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_loadbalancers, a.avg_loadbalancers AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.total_loadbalancers > a.avg_loadbalancers * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_COUNT' WHEN i.total_loadbalancers < a.avg_loadbalancers * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_COUNT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_COUNT' END AS count_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, stats.BYTES_IN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), tenant_avg AS (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID) SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, i.NAME, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, i.BYTES_IN, i.window_column, ta.avg_total_connections AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > ta.avg_total_connections * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_CONN' WHEN i.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS < ta.avg_total_connections * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_CONN' ELSE 'AVG_CONN' END AS connection_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = i.NAME AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = i.VIP_ADDRESS JOIN tenant_avg AS ta ON ta.TENANT_ID = lb.TENANT_ID

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, AVG(n.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY n.STATUS ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.window_column, overall_avg.avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(status_avg_admin_state_up) AS avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up FROM (SELECT STATUS, AVG(ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS status_avg_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte GROUP BY STATUS) AS sub) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.NAME), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, AVG(n.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (PARTITION BY n.STATUS ORDER BY n.NAME) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT AVG(ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS benchmark_admin_state_up FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NETWORK_ID, i.NAME, i.STATUS, i.ADMIN_STATE_UP, i.window_column, b.benchmark_admin_state_up AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.ADMIN_STATE_UP > b.benchmark_admin_state_up THEN 'ABOVE_BENCHMARK' WHEN i.ADMIN_STATE_UP < b.benchmark_admin_state_up THEN 'BELOW_BENCHMARK' ELSE 'AT_BENCHMARK' END AS benchmark_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ORDER BY i.NAME) SELECT q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.NAME, q1.STATUS, q1.ADMIN_STATE_UP, q1.window_column AS avg_admin_state_up_within_status_ordered_by_name, q1.avg_of_status_avg_admin_state_up AS overall_avg_of_per_status_avgs, q2.benchmark AS overall_benchmark_admin_state_up, q2.benchmark_category FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NETWORK_ID = q2.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY q1.NAME

WITH sg_spread_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MAX(port_pair_count) - MIN(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_range, VARIANCE(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_variance, STDDEV(port_pair_count) AS pair_count_stddev FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS port_pair_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID GROUP BY p.ID) AS port_stats ON sgpb.PORT_ID = port_stats.port_id GROUP BY sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY pair_count_range DESC), AverageRange AS (SELECT AVG(pair_count_range) AS avg_pair_count_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, ic.pair_count_range, ic.pair_count_variance, ic.pair_count_stddev, ar.avg_pair_count_range AS benchmark, CASE WHEN ic.pair_count_range > ar.avg_pair_count_range * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_SPREAD' WHEN ic.pair_count_range < ar.avg_pair_count_range * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_SPREAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE_SPREAD' END AS spread_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN AverageRange AS ar), port_25d421c1_allowed_pairs AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address) SELECT p.allowed_mac_address, p.allowed_ip_address, p.port_id, p.security_group_id, p.window_column, p.deviation_from_avg_window, s.pair_count_range, s.pair_count_variance, s.pair_count_stddev, s.benchmark AS avg_pair_count_range_benchmark, s.spread_category FROM port_25d421c1_allowed_pairs AS p JOIN sg_spread_stats AS s ON s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID = p.security_group_id ORDER BY p.allowed_ip_address

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC) SELECT inner_cte.subnet_name, inner_cte.avg_dns_order, inner_cte.dns_order_variance, overall_avg.avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte, (SELECT AVG(avg_dns_order) AS avg_of_subnet_avg_dns_order FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ORDER BY inner_cte.dns_order_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) AS avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.security_group_binding_count, i.dns_record_count, (i.security_group_binding_count - a.avg_sg_binding_count) AS deviation_from_avg_sg_binding_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), NetworkStatusExternal AS (SELECT n.status, CASE WHEN NOT en.network_id IS NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.id = nsb.network_id LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON n.id = en.network_id GROUP BY n.status, external_status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE nse.status END AS network_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(nse.external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(nse.status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE nse.external_status END AS external_status, VARIANCE(nse.port_security_enabled_variance) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nse.port_security_enabled_stddev) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusExternal AS nse CROSS JOIN inner_cte GROUP BY nse.status, nse.external_status WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE'), provider_avg AS (SELECT pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME) SELECT i.loadbalancer_id, i.loadbalancer_name, i.provider_name, i.vip_address, i.window_column AS rank_within_provider_by_total_connections, (stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS - pa.avg_total_connections) AS deviation_from_provider_avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.loadbalancer_id JOIN provider_avg AS pa ON pa.provider_name = i.provider_name

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`ORDER`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`ORDER`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`ORDER`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(coefficient_of_variation) AS avg_coefficient_of_variation FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.coefficient_of_variation, (i.coefficient_of_variation - a.avg_coefficient_of_variation) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE'), ProviderAverages AS (SELECT provider_name, AVG(total_connections) AS avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte GROUP BY provider_name) SELECT i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address, i.bytes_in, i.total_connections, i.provider_name, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ProviderAverages AS pa ON i.provider_name = pa.provider_name WHERE i.total_connections > pa.avg_total_connections

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(t2.`ORDER`) AS min_dns_order, AVG(t1.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version FROM `subnetroutes` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.SUBNET_ID = t1.ID JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.SUBNET_ID WHERE t1.IP_VERSION = 4 AND t2.ADDRESS = '10.107.23.242/8' GROUP BY t1.NAME) SELECT inner_cte.min_dns_order, inner_cte.avg_ip_version, overall_avg.avg_min_dns_order FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(min_dns_order) AS avg_min_dns_order FROM inner_cte) AS overall_avg ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DhcpAverages AS (SELECT ENABLE_DHCP, AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_next2 FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DhcpAverages AS d ON i.ENABLE_DHCP = d.ENABLE_DHCP WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > d.avg_max_next2

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, stats.BYTES_IN, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.TENANT_ID ORDER BY lb.ID) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE') SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS, inner_cte.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS, inner_cte.BYTES_IN, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_avg.avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON lb.ID = stats.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID) AS tenant_avg ON tenant_avg.TENANT_ID = (SELECT lb2.TENANT_ID FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 WHERE lb2.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.VIP_ADDRESS LIMIT 1)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT lb.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, MAX(inner_cte.total_connections) AS max_total_connections FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.NAME = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS = inner_cte.vip_address GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(t2.`ORDER`) AS min_dns_order, AVG(t1.IP_VERSION) AS avg_ip_version FROM `subnetroutes` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.SUBNET_ID = t1.ID JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.SUBNET_ID WHERE t1.IP_VERSION = 4 AND t2.ADDRESS = '10.107.23.242/8' GROUP BY t1.NAME) SELECT min_dns_order, avg_ip_version FROM inner_cte WHERE min_dns_order > 0

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(network_status) OVER (ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status) = network_status THEN NULL ELSE network_status END AS network_status, networks_count, port_security_enabled_variance, port_security_enabled_stddev FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(n.STATUS) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE n.STATUS END AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS networks_count, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.network_status = n.STATUS WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, ic.port_security_enabled_variance, ic.port_security_enabled_stddev WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY network_status_sort, network_status

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), TenantStatusCounts AS (SELECT i.tenant_id, i.status, COUNT(DISTINCT i.network_id) AS total_networks FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.tenant_id, i.status) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(tenant_id) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE tenant_id END AS tenant_id, CASE WHEN GROUPING(status) = 1 AND GROUPING(tenant_id) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE status END AS status, SUM(total_networks) AS total_networks FROM TenantStatusCounts GROUP BY tenant_id, status WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC), RouteCounts AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS distinct_route_destinations FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.subnet_name END AS subnet_name, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(i.first_ip_range) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_range AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_range, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.subnet_name) = 0 AND GROUPING(i.first_ip_variance) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE CAST(i.first_ip_variance AS CHAR) END AS first_ip_variance, SUM(COALESCE(rc.distinct_route_destinations, 0)) AS distinct_route_destinations FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN RouteCounts AS rc ON rc.subnet_name = i.subnet_name GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.name AS port_name, COUNT(sgpb.security_group_id) AS security_group_binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN pd.port_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS dns_record_count FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.port_id = p.id LEFT JOIN `portdnses` AS pd ON p.id = pd.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.name) SELECT port_id, tenant_id, port_name, security_group_binding_count, dns_record_count FROM inner_cte WHERE security_group_binding_count > (SELECT AVG(security_group_binding_count) FROM inner_cte)

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), NetworkRbacCounts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(r.id) AS total_rbacs FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name AND n.status = i.status AND n.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up JOIN NetworkRbacCounts AS c ON c.network_id = n.id WHERE c.total_rbacs > (SELECT AVG(total_rbacs) FROM NetworkRbacCounts)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE'), rbac_counts AS (SELECT n.id AS network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.target_tenant) AS distinct_target_tenants FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY n.id) SELECT i.name, i.status, i.admin_state_up, i.action, i.target_tenant, c.distinct_target_tenants, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN rbac_counts AS c ON c.network_id = (SELECT n2.id FROM `networks` AS n2 WHERE n2.name = i.name AND n2.status = i.status AND n2.admin_state_up = i.admin_state_up LIMIT 1)) SELECT q1.name, q1.status, q1.admin_state_up, q1.action, q1.target_tenant, q2.distinct_target_tenants, q1.window_column FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.name = q2.name AND q1.status = q2.status AND q1.admin_state_up = q2.admin_state_up AND q1.action = q2.action AND q1.target_tenant = q2.target_tenant AND q1.window_column = q2.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy' AND lb.VIP_ADDRESS IN ('10.20.127.222/8')) SELECT MAX(bytes_in) AS max_bytes_in FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN (SELECT subnets.id FROM `subnets` JOIN `networks` ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE NOT networks.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in, CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN s.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > 10000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_lb_over_10000_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.OPERATING_STATUS = i.OPERATING_STATUS JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON s.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.total_bytes_in ORDER BY i.total_bytes_in DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, CASE WHEN NOT sa.DESCRIPTION IS NULL AND sa.DESCRIPTION <> '' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_description FROM inner_cte JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = inner_cte.NAME JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_qualifying_networks, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.target_tenant <> '*' THEN r.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_targeted_rbac FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.name = i.name JOIN `externalnetworks` AS e ON e.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE e.is_default = 0 AND r.action = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_networks DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC) SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT n.ID) AS total_networks_with_security_binding, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID JOIN inner_cte ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_variance, inner_cte.port_security_enabled_stddev ORDER BY total_networks_with_security_binding DESC LIMIT 10

WITH DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT d2.address) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_dns_nameservers FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.name = i.subnet_name LEFT JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d2 ON d2.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY i.subnet_name, i.order_range, i.order_variance ORDER BY i.order_range DESC LIMIT 10), SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT i.NAME, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s2 ON s2.TENANT_ID = i.TENANT_ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p2 ON p2.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID WHERE i.FIRST_IP = (SELECT MIN(p3.FIRST_IP) FROM `ipallocationpools` AS p3 WHERE p3.SUBNET_ID = s2.ID)) SELECT sap.NAME AS subnet_name, sap.TENANT_ID, sap.NETWORK_ID, sap.IP_VERSION, sap.CIDR, sap.GATEWAY_IP, sap.ENABLE_DHCP, sap.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sap.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sap.max_standard_attr_id_next2, dor.order_range, dor.order_variance, dor.has_dns_nameservers FROM SubnetAllocationPoolMinFirstIp AS sap JOIN DnsOrderRangeTop10 AS dor ON dor.subnet_name = sap.NAME WHERE dor.has_dns_nameservers = 'Yes' ORDER BY dor.order_range DESC, sap.NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND lb.VIP_SUBNET_ID IN (SELECT subnets.id FROM `subnets` JOIN `networks` ON networks.id = subnets.network_id WHERE NOT networks.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))) GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT lb.TENANT_ID, MAX(inner_cte.total_bytes_in) AS max_total_bytes_in_across_statuses FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.OPERATING_STATUS = inner_cte.OPERATING_STATUS WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.TENANT_ID HAVING MAX(inner_cte.total_bytes_in) > 1000000

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.status = i.port_status AND p.device_owner = i.device_owner JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.id = p.standard_attr_id LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON p.id = f.fixed_port_id WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports' AND NOT p.network_id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update ORDER BY i.port_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH port_status_owner_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_count) AS avg_port_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.port_status, i.device_owner, i.port_count, i.earliest_standard_attr_update, (i.port_count - a.avg_port_count) AS deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a), default_external_networks_by_tenant AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT e.NETWORK_ID, e.IS_DEFAULT, n.TENANT_ID, n.NAME, n.STATUS, n.ADMIN_STATE_UP, n.MTU, n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, MIN(n.MTU) OVER (PARTITION BY n.TENANT_ID ORDER BY n.TENANT_ID) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0) SELECT inner_cte.NETWORK_ID, inner_cte.IS_DEFAULT, inner_cte.TENANT_ID, inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.STATUS, inner_cte.ADMIN_STATE_UP, inner_cte.MTU, inner_cte.STANDARD_ATTR_ID, inner_cte.window_column, tenant_counts.total_default_external_networks, avg_counts.avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT TENANT_ID, COUNT(NETWORK_ID) AS total_default_external_networks FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TENANT_ID) AS tenant_counts ON inner_cte.TENANT_ID = tenant_counts.TENANT_ID JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant FROM (SELECT COUNT(NETWORK_ID) AS cnt FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TENANT_ID) AS sub) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1) SELECT den.TENANT_ID, den.NETWORK_ID, den.IS_DEFAULT, den.NAME AS network_name, den.STATUS AS network_status, den.ADMIN_STATE_UP, den.MTU, den.STANDARD_ATTR_ID AS network_standard_attr_id, den.window_column AS min_mtu_within_tenant, den.total_default_external_networks, den.avg_default_external_networks_per_tenant, pso.port_status, pso.device_owner, pso.port_count, pso.earliest_standard_attr_update, pso.deviation_from_avg_port_count FROM default_external_networks_by_tenant AS den LEFT JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = den.NETWORK_ID LEFT JOIN port_status_owner_stats AS pso ON pso.port_status = p.STATUS AND pso.device_owner = p.DEVICE_OWNER ORDER BY den.TENANT_ID, den.NETWORK_ID, pso.port_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(ia.ip_address) AS ip_allocation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ia.subnet_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subnet_id_rows FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON psb.port_id = p.id JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = p.id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND NOT ia.ip_address IS NULL AND p.tenant_id IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.ip_allocation_count, i.subnet_id_rows ORDER BY i.ip_allocation_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.NAME, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetRouteCounts AS (SELECT s.ID AS subnet_id, COUNT(r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM `subnets` AS s LEFT JOIN `subnetroutes` AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.ID), AverageRoutes AS (SELECT AVG(total_routes) AS avg_routes FROM SubnetRouteCounts) SELECT i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, src.total_routes, ar.avg_routes AS benchmark, CASE WHEN src.total_routes > ar.avg_routes * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ROUTE_SUBNET' WHEN src.total_routes < ar.avg_routes * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ROUTE_SUBNET' ELSE 'AVERAGE_ROUTE_SUBNET' END AS route_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name AND s.CIDR = i.subnet_cidr JOIN SubnetRouteCounts AS src ON src.subnet_id = s.ID CROSS JOIN AverageRoutes AS ar

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.ACTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external'), tenant_counts AS (SELECT n.TENANT_ID, COUNT(*) AS tenant_network_count FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external' GROUP BY n.TENANT_ID), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(tenant_network_count) AS avg_networks_per_tenant FROM tenant_counts) SELECT inner_cte.NAME, inner_cte.window_column, totals.total_matching_networks, avg_counts.avg_networks_per_tenant FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_matching_networks FROM `externalnetworks` AS e JOIN `networks` AS n ON e.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.ID = r.OBJECT_ID WHERE e.IS_DEFAULT = 0 AND r.ACTION = 'access_as_external') AS totals ON 1 = 1 JOIN avg_counts ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 AND p.tenant_id IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.binding_count, i.port_security_enabled_total, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.id) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ips FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON i.port_id = f.fixed_port_id GROUP BY i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.mac_address, i.binding_count, i.port_security_enabled_total

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(p.FIRST_IP) - MIN(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_range, VARIANCE(p.FIRST_IP) AS first_ip_variance FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY first_ip_range DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name_sort, subnet_name) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, first_ip_range, first_ip_variance, total_routes FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(s.NAME) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE s.NAME END AS subnet_name_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(s.NAME) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE s.NAME END AS subnet_name, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance, COUNT(DISTINCT r.DESTINATION) AS total_routes FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.NAME = i.subnet_name JOIN `subnetroutes` AS r ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID WHERE r.NEXTHOP = '10.30.19.197/8' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME, i.first_ip_range, i.first_ip_variance WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY subnet_name_sort

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, MAX(destination_count) AS max_destinations_per_nexthop FROM (SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP, COUNT(DISTINCT DESTINATION) AS destination_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr, NEXTHOP) AS t GROUP BY subnet_name, subnet_cidr

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, MAX(route_count) - MIN(route_count) AS route_count_range, VARIANCE(route_count) AS route_count_variance, STDDEV(route_count) AS route_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN (SELECT sr.SUBNET_ID, COUNT(*) AS route_count FROM `subnetroutes` AS sr GROUP BY sr.SUBNET_ID, sr.NEXTHOP) AS route_stats ON s.ID = route_stats.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY route_count_range DESC) SELECT s.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, COUNT(sr.DESTINATION) AS total_routes, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_range) AS route_count_range, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_variance) AS route_count_variance, MAX(inner_cte.route_count_stddev) AS route_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `subnetroutes` AS sr ON s.ID = sr.SUBNET_ID JOIN inner_cte ON inner_cte.subnet_name = s.NAME WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') GROUP BY s.TENANT_ID ORDER BY total_routes DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, (i.port_security_enabled_variance - a.avg_variance) AS deviation_from_avg_variance FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')

SELECT MIN(t0.ID) AS min_rbac_id, AVG(t1.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS t0 JOIN `subnets` AS t1 ON t0.OBJECT_ID = t1.NETWORK_ID WHERE t0.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND t0.TARGET_TENANT = '*' GROUP BY t1.NETWORK_ID

SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, AVG(p.FIRST_IP) OVER (PARTITION BY r.NEXTHOP ORDER BY r.DESTINATION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ORDER BY r.DESTINATION

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_networks_with_ports_tag FROM `tags` AS t JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON t.STANDARD_ATTR_ID = sa.ID JOIN `networks` AS n ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND t.TAG = 'ports' AND NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))

SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_ipv4_dhcp_opts FROM `ml2_dvr_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `extradhcpopts` AS e ON p.ID = e.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND e.IP_VERSION = 4 AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))

SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, AVG(s.IP_VERSION) OVER (PARTITION BY s.ID ORDER BY r.DESTINATION) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.NAME = 'shift3' AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48') ORDER BY r.DESTINATION

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_admin_up_networks_with_qos_and_security FROM `qos_network_policy_bindings` AS qnpb JOIN `networks` AS n ON qnpb.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND n.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND n.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_floating_ips_on_active_networks FROM `floatingips` AS f JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON f.STANDARD_ATTR_ID = sa.ID JOIN `networks` AS n ON sa.ID = n.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE f.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND n.STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND f.FIXED_IP_ADDRESS IN ('10.20.127.222/8')

SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, s.tenant_id, s.network_id, s.ip_version, s.cidr, s.gateway_ip, d.address AS dns_address, d.`ORDER` AS dns_order, p.first_ip, p.last_ip, MAX(d.`ORDER`) OVER (ORDER BY s.id, d.`ORDER` ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_dns_order_next_2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id WHERE s.enable_dhcp = 1 AND s.id IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48', '0807c5b3-aa6c-4108-8884-7b4948a19178', '0814cd95-6c95-4669-8415-e555344bb15b', '16eaae8c-1920-4b8b-8765-f149dde8a1a6', '1e360a1e-339a-4dc7-a250-28c31fcd905a', '2019039a-089f-408c-b080-201a0c5cbe6f', '25a309b3-7334-44b7-99b5-85a874d28475', '25e390e6-3a89-42d7-a5e8-c4da22edc587', '26a23140-1cb7-4ccd-b2d7-50611eb82663', '2f08159a-e945-4ba2-a583-431d1f8078d9')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS down_ports_with_ipv4_dhcpopt_and_qos_policy FROM `qos_port_policy_bindings` AS qppb JOIN `ports` AS p ON qppb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `extradhcpopts` AS e ON p.ID = e.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND e.IP_VERSION = 4 AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), PortOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), NetworkPortCountsByStatus AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, COUNT(p.ID) AS total_ports_in_status FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.NETWORK_ID = n.ID JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY n.STATUS) SELECT nss.network_status, nss.port_security_enabled_variance, nss.port_security_enabled_stddev, npc.total_ports_in_status, pos.port_status, pos.device_owner, pos.port_count, pos.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkSecurityStats AS nss JOIN NetworkPortCountsByStatus AS npc ON nss.network_status = npc.network_status JOIN PortOwnerStats AS pos ON pos.port_status = nss.network_status ORDER BY npc.total_ports_in_status DESC, nss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC, pos.port_count DESC) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.network_status) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE i.network_status END AS network_status, CASE WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.network_status) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(external_status) = 1 AND GROUPING(i.network_status) = 1 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE external_status END AS external_status, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_variance) AS sum_port_security_enabled_variance, SUM(i.port_security_enabled_stddev) AS sum_port_security_enabled_stddev, SUM(i.total_ports_in_status) AS sum_total_ports_in_status, i.port_status, i.device_owner, SUM(i.port_count) AS port_count, MIN(i.earliest_standard_attr_update) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, CASE WHEN NOT en.network_id IS NULL THEN 'External' ELSE 'Internal' END AS external_status FROM inner_cte JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.STATUS = inner_cte.network_status LEFT JOIN `externalnetworks` AS en ON en.NETWORK_ID = n.ID) AS i GROUP BY i.network_status, external_status, i.port_status, i.device_owner WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subnet_details AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), top_shared_networks AS (SELECT n.OBJECT_ID AS network_id, COUNT(*) AS subnet_count FROM `networkrbacs` AS n JOIN `subnets` AS s ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' GROUP BY n.OBJECT_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tsn.network_id, tsn.subnet_count, sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM top_shared_networks AS tsn JOIN subnet_details AS sd ON sd.NETWORK_ID = tsn.network_id ORDER BY tsn.subnet_count DESC, tsn.network_id, sd.NAME) SELECT i.network_id, i.subnet_count, i.subnet_name, i.subnet_tenant_id, i.IP_VERSION, i.CIDR, i.GATEWAY_IP, i.ENABLE_DHCP, i.allocation_pool_first_ip, i.allocation_pool_last_ip, i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(max_standard_attr_id_next2) AS avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM inner_cte) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.max_standard_attr_id_next2 > a.avg_max_standard_attr_id_next2 ORDER BY i.subnet_count DESC, i.network_id, i.subnet_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HapLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), OperatingStatusBytesIn AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT hlb.NAME, hlb.ID, hlb.VIP_ADDRESS, hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, hlb.OPERATING_STATUS, hlb.window_column, osbi.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancers AS hlb JOIN OperatingStatusBytesIn AS osbi ON hlb.OPERATING_STATUS = osbi.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY hlb.NAME), StatusPerLbConnections AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, SUM(s.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS per_lb_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS, lb.ID), StatusMaxConnections AS (SELECT OPERATING_STATUS, MAX(per_lb_total_connections) AS max_per_lb_total_connections FROM StatusPerLbConnections GROUP BY OPERATING_STATUS) SELECT i.NAME, i.ID, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.PROVISIONING_STATUS, i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.window_column, i.total_bytes_in, smc.max_per_lb_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN StatusMaxConnections AS smc ON i.OPERATING_STATUS = smc.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY i.NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DnsOrderStats AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(d.`ORDER`) - MIN(d.`ORDER`) AS order_range, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.id = d.subnet_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY order_range DESC), SubnetRoutePoolDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT srpd.subnet_name, srpd.subnet_cidr, srpd.DESTINATION, srpd.NEXTHOP, srpd.FIRST_IP, srpd.LAST_IP, srpd.window_column, dos.order_range, dos.order_variance FROM SubnetRoutePoolDetails AS srpd JOIN DnsOrderStats AS dos ON srpd.subnet_name = dos.subnet_name ORDER BY srpd.subnet_name, srpd.window_column, srpd.DESTINATION), AvgDnsOrderRange AS (SELECT AVG(order_range) AS avg_order_range FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, i.order_range, i.order_variance, (i.order_range - a.avg_order_range) AS deviation_from_avg_order_range FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgDnsOrderRange AS a ORDER BY i.subnet_name, i.window_column, i.DESTINATION

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AllowedAddressPairsOnPort AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), AdminUpPortBindingDetails AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1), AdminUpDetailsForTargetPort AS (SELECT * FROM AdminUpPortBindingDetails WHERE PORT_ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034') SELECT aap.allowed_mac_address, aap.allowed_ip_address, aap.port_id, aap.security_group_id, aap.window_column AS allowed_address_pairs_running_avg_standard_attr_id, t.HOST, t.VIF_TYPE, t.VNIC_TYPE, t.TENANT_ID, t.NETWORK_ID, t.MAC_ADDRESS, t.STATUS, t.DEVICE_OWNER, t.window_column AS admin_up_ports_window_avg_standard_attr_id FROM AllowedAddressPairsOnPort AS aap LEFT JOIN AdminUpDetailsForTargetPort AS t ON aap.port_id = t.PORT_ID ORDER BY aap.allowed_ip_address), TargetPortNetwork AS (SELECT p.network_id FROM `ports` AS p WHERE p.id = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034'), NetworkSecurityGroups AS (SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, COUNT(DISTINCT spb.security_group_id) AS security_group_count FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS spb ON p.id = spb.port_id JOIN TargetPortNetwork AS tpn ON p.network_id = tpn.network_id GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id), NetworkMaxSecurityGroups AS (SELECT network_id, MAX(security_group_count) AS max_security_groups_on_any_port FROM NetworkSecurityGroups GROUP BY network_id) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.allowed_address_pairs_running_avg_standard_attr_id, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.admin_up_ports_window_avg_standard_attr_id, nmsg.max_security_groups_on_any_port FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN NetworkMaxSecurityGroups AS nmsg ON i.NETWORK_ID = nmsg.network_id ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), subq2 AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE') SELECT s1.NAME AS load_balancer_name, s1.ID AS load_balancer_id, s1.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, s1.PROVISIONING_STATUS AS provisioning_status, s1.OPERATING_STATUS AS operating_status, s1.window_column AS running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, s2.provider_name, s2.window_column AS rank_within_provider_by_total_connections FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.ID = s2.loadbalancer_id ORDER BY s1.NAME), AvgConnections AS (SELECT AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id) SELECT i.load_balancer_name, i.load_balancer_id, i.vip_address, i.provisioning_status, i.operating_status, i.running_avg_loadbalancer_id_within_provider_ordered_by_name, i.provider_name, i.rank_within_provider_by_total_connections, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, (stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS - ac.avg_total_connections) AS deviation_from_avg_total_connections FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.load_balancer_id CROSS JOIN AvgConnections AS ac ORDER BY i.load_balancer_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.TENANT_ID AS tenant_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.NETWORK_ID AS network_id, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.NETWORK_ID ORDER BY p.ID) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN'), PortSecurityBindingStatsByStatus AS (SELECT p.status, MAX(ps.binding_count) - MIN(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_range, VARIANCE(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_variance, STDDEV(ps.binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev FROM `ports` AS p JOIN (SELECT p2.id AS port_id, COUNT(*) AS binding_count FROM `ports` AS p2 JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS b ON p2.id = b.port_id GROUP BY p2.id) AS ps ON p.id = ps.port_id GROUP BY p.status ORDER BY binding_count_range DESC), DownPortCountsByNetwork AS (SELECT network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT port_id) AS down_port_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs GROUP BY network_id) SELECT d.port_id, d.tenant_id, d.port_name, d.network_id, d.mac_address, d.device_owner, d.ip_address, d.window_column, ps.status, ps.binding_count_range, ps.binding_count_variance, ps.binding_count_stddev, c.down_port_count FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN PortSecurityBindingStatsByStatus AS ps ON ps.status = 'DOWN' JOIN DownPortCountsByNetwork AS c ON d.network_id = c.network_id ORDER BY d.network_id, d.window_column), SubnetAllocations AS (SELECT ia.subnet_id, ia.network_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ia.ip_address) AS allocated_ips FROM `ipallocations` AS ia GROUP BY ia.subnet_id, ia.network_id), AverageAllocations AS (SELECT AVG(allocated_ips) AS avg_ips FROM SubnetAllocations) SELECT i.port_id, i.tenant_id, i.port_name, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.ip_address, i.window_column, i.status, i.binding_count_range, i.binding_count_variance, i.binding_count_stddev, i.down_port_count, ia.subnet_id, sa.allocated_ips AS subnet_allocated_ips, (sa.allocated_ips - aa.avg_ips) AS subnet_deviation_from_avg_allocated_ips FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON ia.port_id = i.port_id AND ia.ip_address = i.ip_address JOIN SubnetAllocations AS sa ON sa.subnet_id = ia.subnet_id AND sa.network_id = ia.network_id CROSS JOIN AverageAllocations AS aa ORDER BY i.network_id, i.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HapLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.NAME, lb.ID, lb.VIP_ADDRESS, lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, lb.OPERATING_STATUS, AVG(lb.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY lb.NAME) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), OperatingStatusBytesIn AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) SELECT hlb.NAME, hlb.ID, hlb.VIP_ADDRESS, hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS, hlb.OPERATING_STATUS, hlb.window_column, osbi.total_bytes_in FROM HapLoadBalancers AS hlb JOIN OperatingStatusBytesIn AS osbi ON hlb.OPERATING_STATUS = osbi.OPERATING_STATUS WHERE hlb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY hlb.NAME), AvgBytesInBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_bytes_in) AS avg_total_bytes_in FROM (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000) AS t) SELECT i.NAME, i.ID, i.VIP_ADDRESS, i.PROVISIONING_STATUS, i.OPERATING_STATUS, i.window_column, i.total_bytes_in, a.avg_total_bytes_in AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.total_bytes_in > a.avg_total_bytes_in * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_BYTES_IN' WHEN i.total_bytes_in < a.avg_total_bytes_in * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_BYTES_IN' ELSE 'AVERAGE_BYTES_IN' END AS bytes_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN AvgBytesInBenchmark AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DnsOrderStats AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, AVG(d.`ORDER`) AS avg_dns_order, VARIANCE(d.`ORDER`) AS dns_order_variance FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON s.ID = d.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 GROUP BY s.NAME ORDER BY dns_order_variance DESC), RoutePoolDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT rpd.subnet_name, rpd.subnet_cidr, rpd.DESTINATION, rpd.NEXTHOP, rpd.FIRST_IP, rpd.LAST_IP, rpd.window_column, dos.avg_dns_order, dos.dns_order_variance FROM RoutePoolDetails AS rpd JOIN DnsOrderStats AS dos ON rpd.subnet_name = dos.subnet_name ORDER BY dos.dns_order_variance DESC, rpd.subnet_name, rpd.window_column), VarianceBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(dns_order_variance) AS avg_dns_order_variance FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.subnet_name, i.subnet_cidr, i.DESTINATION, i.NEXTHOP, i.FIRST_IP, i.LAST_IP, i.window_column, i.avg_dns_order, i.dns_order_variance, vb.avg_dns_order_variance AS benchmark_dns_order_variance, CASE WHEN i.dns_order_variance > vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.dns_order_variance < vb.avg_dns_order_variance * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark AS vb ORDER BY i.dns_order_variance DESC, i.subnet_name, i.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH AdminUpPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1), DownPortsWithIPs AS (SELECT p.ID AS port_id, p.NAME AS port_name, p.MAC_ADDRESS AS mac_address, ia.IP_ADDRESS AS ip_address, ia.SUBNET_ID AS subnet_id, AVG(p.ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' ORDER BY ia.IP_ADDRESS), CombinedPorts AS (SELECT a.PORT_ID AS port_id, a.HOST, a.VIF_TYPE, a.VNIC_TYPE, a.TENANT_ID, a.NETWORK_ID, a.MAC_ADDRESS, a.STATUS, a.DEVICE_OWNER, a.window_column AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, NULL AS port_name, NULL AS ip_address, NULL AS subnet_id, NULL AS down_window_avg_port_id, 'Admin State Up' AS reason FROM AdminUpPorts AS a UNION ALL SELECT d.port_id, NULL AS HOST, NULL AS VIF_TYPE, NULL AS VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, d.mac_address AS MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, NULL AS admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, d.port_name, d.ip_address, d.subnet_id, d.window_column AS down_window_avg_port_id, 'Status DOWN' AS reason FROM DownPortsWithIPs AS d JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.ID = d.port_id WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1) SELECT * FROM CombinedPorts ORDER BY port_id, reason), NetworkPortWindowMetric AS (SELECT p.network_id, p.id AS port_id, MAX(COALESCE(inner_cte.admin_up_window_avg_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.down_window_avg_port_id)) AS port_window_metric FROM inner_cte JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.id = inner_cte.port_id GROUP BY p.network_id, p.id) SELECT network_id, MAX(port_window_metric) AS max_port_window_metric FROM NetworkPortWindowMetric GROUP BY network_id
