WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetDetails AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), SubnetRouteDetails AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, sd.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, srd.DESTINATION AS route_destination, srd.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, srd.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM SubnetDetails AS sd LEFT JOIN SubnetRouteDetails AS srd ON sd.NAME = srd.subnet_name AND sd.CIDR = srd.subnet_cidr AND sd.FIRST_IP = srd.FIRST_IP AND sd.LAST_IP = srd.LAST_IP ORDER BY sd.NAME, srd.window_column, srd.DESTINATION), RoutePresenceSummary AS (SELECT ic.ENABLE_DHCP, CASE WHEN NOT ic.route_destination IS NULL THEN 'Has Routes' ELSE 'No Routes' END AS route_presence, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.ENABLE_DHCP, route_presence) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(ENABLE_DHCP) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE CAST(ENABLE_DHCP AS CHAR) END AS enable_dhcp, CASE WHEN GROUPING(route_presence) = 1 AND GROUPING(ENABLE_DHCP) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' ELSE route_presence END AS route_presence, SUM(total_rows) AS total_rows FROM RoutePresenceSummary GROUP BY ENABLE_DHCP, route_presence WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'), Subq2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT q2.NAME AS subnet_name, q2.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, q2.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, q2.NETWORK_ID AS subnet_network_id, q2.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, q2.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, q2.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, q2.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, q2.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, q1.rbac_target_tenant, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ROUND(q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2 / NULLIF(q1.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Subq2 AS q2 JOIN Subq1 AS q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.CIDR ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC), Agg AS (SELECT rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp, COUNT(DISTINCT subnet_name) AS distinct_subnets, ROUND(AVG(max_to_running_sum_ratio), 2) AS avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp) SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 THEN 'GRAND TOTAL' ELSE rbac_target_tenant END AS rbac_target_tenant, CASE WHEN GROUPING(enable_dhcp) = 1 AND GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 0 THEN 'SUBTOTAL' WHEN GROUPING(enable_dhcp) = 1 AND GROUPING(rbac_target_tenant) = 1 THEN 'ALL' ELSE CAST(enable_dhcp AS CHAR) END AS enable_dhcp, SUM(distinct_subnets) AS distinct_subnets, ROUND(AVG(avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio), 2) AS avg_max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Agg GROUP BY rbac_target_tenant, enable_dhcp WITH ROLLUP

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM `subnets` AS s2 JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DnsSubnetNames AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName AS sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames AS dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME), NetworkMaxPoolRange AS (SELECT s.network_id, MAX(ic.pool_count_range) AS max_pool_count_range_in_network FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `subnets` AS s ON s.name = ic.subnet_name GROUP BY s.network_id) SELECT ic.subnet_name, ic.tenant_id, ic.network_id, ic.ip_version, ic.cidr, ic.gateway_ip, ic.enable_dhcp, ic.first_ip, ic.last_ip, ic.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ic.pool_count_range, ic.pool_count_variance, ic.pool_count_stddev, nmr.max_pool_count_range_in_network FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN NetworkMaxPoolRange AS nmr ON nmr.network_id = ic.network_id ORDER BY nmr.max_pool_count_range_in_network DESC, ic.pool_count_range DESC, ic.subnet_name

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared'), Subq2 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4) SELECT q2.NAME AS subnet_name, q2.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, q2.TENANT_ID AS subnet_tenant_id, q2.NETWORK_ID AS subnet_network_id, q2.IP_VERSION AS ip_version, q2.GATEWAY_IP AS gateway_ip, q2.ENABLE_DHCP AS enable_dhcp, q2.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, q2.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, q1.rbac_target_tenant, q1.window_column AS running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2, ROUND(q2.max_standard_attr_id_next2 / NULLIF(q1.window_column, 0), 2) AS max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM Subq2 AS q2 JOIN Subq1 AS q1 ON q1.subnet_name = q2.NAME AND q1.subnet_cidr = q2.CIDR ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC) SELECT subnet_name, subnet_cidr, subnet_tenant_id, subnet_network_id, ip_version, gateway_ip, enable_dhcp, allocation_pool_first_ip, allocation_pool_last_ip, rbac_target_tenant, running_sum_standard_attr_id_within_ip_version, max_standard_attr_id_next2, max_to_running_sum_ratio FROM inner_cte WHERE max_to_running_sum_ratio > (SELECT AVG(max_to_running_sum_ratio) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY max_to_running_sum_ratio DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH HostPortMaxAttr AS (SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1), StatusAttrVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT hpma.HOST, hpma.STATUS, hpma.max_standard_attr_id, sav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM HostPortMaxAttr AS hpma JOIN StatusAttrVariance AS sav ON hpma.STATUS = sav.STATUS) SELECT i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ia.PORT_ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_ip_allocation_in_group FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON i.HOST = b.HOST JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID AND p.STATUS = i.STATUS LEFT JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID GROUP BY i.HOST, i.STATUS, i.max_standard_attr_id, i.standard_attr_id_variance

WITH TopTenTenants AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lb.id) AS total_qualifying_loadbalancers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN inner_cte.operating_status = 'ONLINE' THEN lb.id END) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_online FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status GROUP BY lb.tenant_id ORDER BY total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC LIMIT 10), TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT lb.tenant_id AS tenant_id, COUNT(inner_cte.loadbalancer_name) AS total_haproxy_loadbalancers, avg_counts.avg_lb_count FROM inner_cte JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON lb.name = inner_cte.loadbalancer_name AND lb.operating_status = inner_cte.operating_status, (SELECT AVG(lb_count) AS avg_lb_count FROM (SELECT lb2.tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS lb_count FROM (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) AS inner2 JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON lb2.name = inner2.loadbalancer_name AND lb2.operating_status = inner2.operating_status GROUP BY lb2.tenant_id) AS sub) AS avg_counts GROUP BY lb.tenant_id, avg_counts.avg_lb_count) SELECT ttt.tenant_id, ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers, tha.avg_lb_count, ttt.has_any_online FROM TopTenTenants AS ttt JOIN TenantHaproxyCountsAndAverage AS tha ON ttt.tenant_id = tha.tenant_id WHERE ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers > tha.avg_lb_count ORDER BY ttt.total_qualifying_loadbalancers DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(status) OVER (ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id) = status THEN NULL ELSE status END AS status, port_id, host, vif_type, vnic_type, tenant_id, network_id, mac_address, device_owner, window_column, min_admin_state_up, avg_standard_attr_id FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'zzz' ELSE i.status END AS status_sort, CASE WHEN GROUPING(i.status) = 1 THEN 'TOTAL' ELSE i.status END AS status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.status, i.port_id, i.host, i.vif_type, i.vnic_type, i.tenant_id, i.network_id, i.mac_address, i.device_owner, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id WITH ROLLUP) AS tbltmp ORDER BY status_sort, status, port_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), PortStatusOwnerStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' AND NOT p.NETWORK_ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, pss.port_status, pss.device_owner, pss.port_count, pss.earliest_standard_attr_update FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss CROSS JOIN PortStatusOwnerStats AS pss) SELECT network_status, MAX(port_count) AS max_port_count_across_port_groups FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_status

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH q1 AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), q2 AS (SELECT r.DESTINATION, r.NEXTHOP, s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.SUBNET_ID ORDER BY r.SUBNET_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnetroutes` AS r JOIN `subnets` AS s ON r.SUBNET_ID = s.ID JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT q1.NAME AS subnet_name, q1.TENANT_ID, q1.NETWORK_ID, q1.IP_VERSION, q1.CIDR, q1.GATEWAY_IP, q1.ENABLE_DHCP, q1.FIRST_IP AS allocation_first_ip, q1.LAST_IP AS allocation_last_ip, q1.max_standard_attr_id_next2, q2.DESTINATION AS route_destination, q2.NEXTHOP AS route_nexthop, q2.window_column AS route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.NAME = q2.subnet_name AND q1.CIDR = q2.subnet_cidr AND q1.FIRST_IP = q2.FIRST_IP AND q1.LAST_IP = q2.LAST_IP ORDER BY q1.NAME, q2.window_column, q2.DESTINATION) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(subnet_name) OVER (ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination) = subnet_name THEN NULL ELSE subnet_name END AS subnet_name, tenant_id, network_id, ip_version, cidr, gateway_ip, enable_dhcp, allocation_first_ip, allocation_last_ip, max_standard_attr_id_next2, route_destination, route_nexthop, route_dense_rank_within_subnet FROM inner_cte ORDER BY subnet_name, route_dense_rank_within_subnet, route_destination

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC), VarianceBenchmark AS (SELECT AVG(port_security_enabled_variance) AS avg_variance_benchmark FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.network_status, i.active_network_count, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, vb.avg_variance_benchmark AS benchmark, CASE WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance > vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_VARIANCE' WHEN i.port_security_enabled_variance < vb.avg_variance_benchmark * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_VARIANCE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_VARIANCE' END AS variance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN VarianceBenchmark AS vb ORDER BY i.active_network_count DESC, i.port_security_enabled_variance DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT network_id, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_standard_attr_id, MAX(min_admin_state_up) AS min_admin_state_up_for_matching_status, AVG(avg_standard_attr_id) AS avg_standard_attr_id_for_matching_status FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TenantAdminUpPorts AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), OvsDeviceStatusStats AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT tap.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT tap.PORT_ID) AS ports_for_tenant_admin_up, AVG(tap.window_column) AS avg_window_standard_attr_id, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id FROM TenantAdminUpPorts AS tap JOIN OvsDeviceStatusStats AS ods ON tap.STATUS = ods.STATUS GROUP BY tap.STATUS, ods.min_admin_state_up, ods.avg_standard_attr_id ORDER BY ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC) SELECT i.STATUS, i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up, i.avg_window_standard_attr_id, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT p.STATUS, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS ovs_device_ports_for_status FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) AS d ON d.STATUS = i.STATUS WHERE d.ovs_device_ports_for_status > 0 AND (i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up * 1.0 / d.ovs_device_ports_for_status) > 0.75 ORDER BY i.ports_for_tenant_admin_up DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT b.PORT_ID, b.HOST, b.VIF_TYPE, b.VNIC_TYPE, p.TENANT_ID, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY b.VIF_TYPE ORDER BY p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.ID = psb.PORT_ID WHERE p.ADMIN_STATE_UP = 1 AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57')), Subquery2 AS (SELECT p.STATUS, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) AS min_admin_state_up, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS avg_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ml2_port_bindings` AS b ON p.ID = b.PORT_ID WHERE b.VIF_TYPE = 'ovs' AND p.DEVICE_ID IN ('da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS) SELECT s1.PORT_ID, s1.HOST, s1.VIF_TYPE, s1.VNIC_TYPE, s1.TENANT_ID, s1.NETWORK_ID, s1.MAC_ADDRESS, s1.STATUS, s1.DEVICE_OWNER, s1.window_column, s2.min_admin_state_up, s2.avg_standard_attr_id FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.STATUS = s2.STATUS) SELECT i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT f.ID) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_floating_ip FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN `floatingips` AS f ON i.PORT_ID = f.FIXED_PORT_ID GROUP BY i.PORT_ID, i.HOST, i.VIF_TYPE, i.VNIC_TYPE, i.TENANT_ID, i.NETWORK_ID, i.MAC_ADDRESS, i.STATUS, i.DEVICE_OWNER, i.window_column, i.min_admin_state_up, i.avg_standard_attr_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH network_status_security_stats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), active_network_rbac_details AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), active_network_rbac_summary AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(*) AS active_network_rbac_row_count FROM active_network_rbac_details GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev, anrs.active_network_rbac_row_count FROM network_status_security_stats AS nsss LEFT JOIN active_network_rbac_summary AS anrs ON anrs.network_status = nsss.network_status) SELECT i.network_status, i.port_security_enabled_variance, i.port_security_enabled_stddev, i.active_network_rbac_row_count, avg_counts.avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(active_network_rbac_row_count) AS avg_active_network_rbac_row_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_counts ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH PortStatusOwnerAgg AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS min_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS spb ON p.ID = spb.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), DownNetworkPortDetails AS (SELECT p.NAME, p.NETWORK_ID, p.MAC_ADDRESS, p.ADMIN_STATE_UP, p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER, s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, MIN(p.ADMIN_STATE_UP) OVER (ORDER BY p.ID ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STATUS = 'DOWN' AND p.NETWORK_ID IN ('0a1d0a27-cffa-4de3-92c5-9d3fd3f2e74d')) SELECT dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id, COUNT(*) AS matching_down_ports_in_network FROM DownNetworkPortDetails AS dnpd JOIN `ports` AS p ON p.MAC_ADDRESS = dnpd.MAC_ADDRESS AND p.NETWORK_ID = dnpd.NETWORK_ID AND p.DEVICE_OWNER = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER AND p.STATUS = dnpd.STATUS JOIN PortStatusOwnerAgg AS psa ON psa.port_status = dnpd.STATUS AND psa.device_owner = dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER WHERE p.TENANT_ID IN ('17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7') GROUP BY dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, psa.port_count, psa.min_standard_attr_id ORDER BY matching_down_ports_in_network DESC, dnpd.DEVICE_OWNER, dnpd.SECURITY_GROUP_ID) SELECT inner_cte.DEVICE_OWNER, inner_cte.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, inner_cte.port_count, inner_cte.min_standard_attr_id, inner_cte.matching_down_ports_in_network, avg_stats.avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT AVG(matching_down_ports_in_network) AS avg_matching_down_ports_in_network FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ON 1 = 1

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM `subnetpools` AS sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank AS sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC) SELECT network_id, MAX(dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio) AS max_dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM inner_cte GROUP BY network_id

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS (SELECT n.STATUS AS network_status, VARIANCE(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_variance, STDDEV(nsb.PORT_SECURITY_ENABLED) AS port_security_enabled_stddev FROM `networks` AS n JOIN `networksecuritybindings` AS nsb ON n.ID = nsb.NETWORK_ID WHERE NOT n.ID IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.STATUS ORDER BY port_security_enabled_variance DESC), ActiveNetworkRbacDetails AS (SELECT n.name, n.status, n.admin_state_up, r.action, r.target_tenant, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.id ORDER BY n.id) AS window_column FROM `networksecuritybindings` AS b JOIN `networks` AS n ON b.network_id = n.id JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON n.id = r.object_id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'))), ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS (SELECT status AS network_status, COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS active_network_count FROM ActiveNetworkRbacDetails GROUP BY status) SELECT nsss.network_status, anc.active_network_count, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance, nsss.port_security_enabled_stddev FROM NetworkStatusSecurityStats AS nsss JOIN ActiveNetworkCountsByStatus AS anc ON nsss.network_status = anc.network_status ORDER BY anc.active_network_count DESC, nsss.port_security_enabled_variance DESC), tenant_active_networks AS (SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT n.id) AS total_active_networks FROM `networks` AS n WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.tenant_id), tenant_rbac_presence AS (SELECT n.tenant_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS total_rbac_rows FROM `networks` AS n LEFT JOIN `networkrbacs` AS r ON r.object_id = n.id WHERE n.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT networkrbacs.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` WHERE networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (networkrbacs.target_tenant = '*' OR networkrbacs.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY n.tenant_id) SELECT tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, CASE WHEN trp.total_rbac_rows > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS has_any_network_rbac, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.network_status) AS statuses_covered_in_inner_cte FROM tenant_active_networks AS tan LEFT JOIN tenant_rbac_presence AS trp ON trp.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.tenant_id = tan.tenant_id LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON ic.network_status = n.status GROUP BY tan.tenant_id, tan.total_active_networks, trp.total_rbac_rows ORDER BY tan.total_active_networks DESC LIMIT 10

WITH port_status_owner_stats AS (SELECT p.STATUS AS port_status, p.DEVICE_OWNER AS device_owner, COUNT(p.ID) AS port_count, MIN(sa.UPDATED_AT) AS earliest_standard_attr_update FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE sa.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports' GROUP BY p.STATUS, p.DEVICE_OWNER), subnet_pool_window AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), subnets_matching_ports_standardattrs AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS matching_subnet_rows_count FROM subnet_pool_window AS spw JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa2 ON sa2.ID = spw.max_standard_attr_id_next2 WHERE sa2.RESOURCE_TYPE = 'ports') SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM port_status_owner_stats) AS port_status_owner_group_count, smp.matching_subnet_rows_count FROM subnets_matching_ports_standardattrs AS smp

WITH SubnetPoolStatsByName AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, MAX(pool_count) - MIN(pool_count) AS pool_count_range, VARIANCE(pool_count) AS pool_count_variance, STDDEV(pool_count) AS pool_count_stddev FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN (SELECT s2.id AS subnet_id, COUNT(*) AS pool_count FROM `subnets` AS s2 JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s2.id GROUP BY s2.id, p.id) AS pool_stats ON pool_stats.subnet_id = s.id GROUP BY s.name ORDER BY pool_count_range DESC), SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4), DnsSubnetNames AS (SELECT DISTINCT s.name AS subnet_name FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id) SELECT sd.NAME AS subnet_name, sd.TENANT_ID, sd.NETWORK_ID, sd.IP_VERSION, sd.CIDR, sd.GATEWAY_IP, sd.ENABLE_DHCP, sd.FIRST_IP, sd.LAST_IP, sd.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sp.pool_count_range, sp.pool_count_variance, sp.pool_count_stddev FROM SubnetDetailsWithWindowMax AS sd JOIN SubnetPoolStatsByName AS sp ON sd.NAME = sp.subnet_name JOIN DnsSubnetNames AS dn ON sd.NAME = dn.subnet_name ORDER BY sp.pool_count_range DESC, sd.NAME

WITH ActiveStatusBytes AS (SELECT lb.OPERATING_STATUS, SUM(s.BYTES_IN) AS total_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS s ON lb.ID = s.LOADBALANCER_ID WHERE lb.PROVISIONING_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY lb.OPERATING_STATUS HAVING SUM(s.BYTES_IN) > 1000000), HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS (SELECT lb.name AS loadbalancer_name, MAX(lb.admin_state_up) AS max_admin_state_up, lb.operating_status FROM `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.id = pra.resource_id WHERE pra.provider_name = 'haproxy' GROUP BY lb.name, lb.operating_status HAVING MAX(lb.admin_state_up) = 1) SELECT h.loadbalancer_name, h.operating_status, a.total_bytes_in FROM HaproxyAdminUpLoadBalancers AS h JOIN ActiveStatusBytes AS a ON h.operating_status = a.OPERATING_STATUS ORDER BY h.operating_status, h.loadbalancer_name

WITH HostPortMaxAttr AS (SELECT b.HOST, MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS max_standard_attr_id, p.STATUS FROM `ml2_port_bindings` AS b JOIN `ports` AS p ON b.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS a ON p.ID = a.PORT_ID WHERE a.IP_ADDRESS = '10.232.210.41/8' GROUP BY b.HOST, p.STATUS HAVING MAX(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) > 1), StatusAttrVariance AS (SELECT p.STATUS, VARIANCE(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS standard_attr_id_variance FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `ipallocations` AS ia ON p.ID = ia.PORT_ID WHERE NOT p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID IS NULL GROUP BY p.STATUS ORDER BY standard_attr_id_variance DESC) SELECT hpma.HOST, hpma.STATUS, hpma.max_standard_attr_id, sav.standard_attr_id_variance FROM HostPortMaxAttr AS hpma JOIN StatusAttrVariance AS sav ON hpma.STATUS = sav.STATUS

WITH sg_geom AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, EXP(AVG(LN(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID))) AS geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `securitygroupportbindings` AS s ON p.ID = s.PORT_ID WHERE p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID > 0 GROUP BY s.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY geometric_mean_standard_attr_id DESC), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.SECURITY_GROUP_ID, i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, (i.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id - a.avg_geometric_mean_standard_attr_id) AS deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean DESC), port_aap_window AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(window_column) AS avg_window_column FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.allowed_mac_address, i.allowed_ip_address, i.port_id, i.security_group_id, i.window_column, (i.window_column - a.avg_window_column) AS deviation_from_avg_window FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a ORDER BY i.allowed_ip_address) SELECT p.allowed_mac_address, p.allowed_ip_address, p.port_id, p.security_group_id, p.window_column, p.deviation_from_avg_window, g.geometric_mean_standard_attr_id, g.deviation_from_avg_geometric_mean FROM port_aap_window AS p JOIN sg_geom AS g ON p.security_group_id = g.SECURITY_GROUP_ID ORDER BY p.allowed_ip_address

WITH AllowedPairsAndSecurityGroups AS (SELECT aap.MAC_ADDRESS AS allowed_mac_address, aap.IP_ADDRESS AS allowed_ip_address, p.ID AS port_id, sgpb.SECURITY_GROUP_ID AS security_group_id, AVG(p.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY p.ID ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS) AS window_column FROM `securitygroupportbindings` AS sgpb JOIN `ports` AS p ON sgpb.PORT_ID = p.ID JOIN `allowedaddresspairs` AS aap ON p.ID = aap.PORT_ID WHERE p.ID = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY aap.IP_ADDRESS), AdminUpPortSecurityStats AS (SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, COUNT(psb.port_id) AS binding_count, SUM(CASE WHEN psb.port_security_enabled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS port_security_enabled_total FROM `ports` AS p JOIN `portsecuritybindings` AS psb ON p.id = psb.port_id WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1 GROUP BY p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address) SELECT apsg.allowed_mac_address, apsg.allowed_ip_address, apsg.port_id, apsg.security_group_id, apsg.window_column, aup.tenant_id, aup.mac_address AS port_mac_address, aup.binding_count, aup.port_security_enabled_total, ROUND(aup.port_security_enabled_total / NULLIF(aup.binding_count, 0), 2) AS normalized_port_security_enabled_ratio FROM AllowedPairsAndSecurityGroups AS apsg JOIN AdminUpPortSecurityStats AS aup ON aup.port_id = apsg.port_id WHERE apsg.port_id = '25d421c1-c76d-4c26-9550-9f871a1d5034' ORDER BY normalized_port_security_enabled_ratio DESC, apsg.allowed_ip_address

WITH SubnetPools AS (SELECT s.NAME, s.TENANT_ID, s.NETWORK_ID, s.IP_VERSION, s.CIDR, s.GATEWAY_IP, s.ENABLE_DHCP, p.FIRST_IP, p.LAST_IP, MAX(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (ORDER BY s.ID ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_standard_attr_id_next2 FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON s.ID = p.SUBNET_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')), SubnetAttrDenseRank AS (SELECT s.NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.UPDATED_AT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `standardattributes` AS sa ON sa.ID = s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID WHERE s.IP_VERSION = 4 AND s.ID IN ('012993ae-5d73-4aad-834b-e87a31e99d48')) SELECT sp.NAME AS subnet_name, sp.TENANT_ID, sp.NETWORK_ID, sp.IP_VERSION, sp.CIDR, sp.GATEWAY_IP, sp.ENABLE_DHCP, sp.FIRST_IP AS allocation_pool_first_ip, sp.LAST_IP AS allocation_pool_last_ip, sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, sadr.window_column AS standard_attr_dense_rank_window, ROUND(sadr.window_column / NULLIF(sp.max_standard_attr_id_next2, 0), 4) AS dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio FROM `subnetpools` AS sp JOIN SubnetAttrDenseRank AS sadr ON sp.NAME = sadr.NAME ORDER BY dense_rank_to_max_attr_ratio DESC

WITH q1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.ID AS loadbalancer_id, lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME ORDER BY stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE'), ProviderAverages AS (SELECT pra.PROVIDER_NAME AS provider_name, AVG(stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS) AS avg_total_connections FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE lb.OPERATING_STATUS = 'ONLINE' GROUP BY pra.PROVIDER_NAME) SELECT i.loadbalancer_id, i.loadbalancer_name, i.provider_name, i.vip_address, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = i.loadbalancer_id WHERE stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS > (SELECT pa.avg_total_connections FROM ProviderAverages AS pa WHERE pa.provider_name = i.provider_name)), q2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lb.NAME AS loadbalancer_name, lb.VIP_ADDRESS AS vip_address, stats.BYTES_IN AS bytes_in, stats.TOTAL_CONNECTIONS AS total_connections, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lb.NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb ON stats.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra ON lb.ID = pra.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy'), haproxy_avg AS (SELECT AVG(stats2.BYTES_IN * 1.0) AS avg_bytes_in FROM `lbaas_loadbalancer_statistics` AS stats2 JOIN `lbaas_loadbalancers` AS lb2 ON stats2.LOADBALANCER_ID = lb2.ID JOIN `providerresourceassociations` AS pra2 ON lb2.ID = pra2.RESOURCE_ID WHERE pra2.PROVIDER_NAME = 'haproxy') SELECT i.loadbalancer_name, i.vip_address, i.bytes_in, i.total_connections, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN haproxy_avg AS a WHERE i.bytes_in > a.avg_bytes_in ORDER BY i.loadbalancer_name) SELECT q1.loadbalancer_id, q1.loadbalancer_name, q1.provider_name, q1.vip_address, q1.window_column AS provider_rank_by_total_connections, q2.bytes_in, q2.total_connections, q2.window_column AS haproxy_row_number_window FROM q1 JOIN q2 ON q1.loadbalancer_name = q2.loadbalancer_name AND q1.vip_address = q2.vip_address WHERE q1.provider_name = 'haproxy'

WITH SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS (SELECT s.name AS subnet_name, STDDEV(d.`order`) / NULLIF(AVG(d.`order`), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `dnsnameservers` AS d ON d.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `ipallocationpools` AS p ON p.subnet_id = s.id JOIN `networks` AS n ON n.id = s.network_id WHERE s.ip_version = 4 AND NOT n.id IN (SELECT r.object_id FROM `networkrbacs` AS r WHERE r.action = 'access_as_shared' AND (r.target_tenant = '*' OR r.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')) GROUP BY s.name HAVING AVG(d.`order`) > 0 ORDER BY coefficient_of_variation DESC), SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS (SELECT s.NAME AS subnet_name, s.CIDR AS subnet_cidr, n.TARGET_TENANT AS rbac_target_tenant, SUM(s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY s.IP_VERSION ORDER BY s.STANDARD_ATTR_ID) AS window_column FROM `subnets` AS s JOIN `networkrbacs` AS n ON n.OBJECT_ID = s.NETWORK_ID WHERE n.ACTION = 'access_as_shared' AND n.TARGET_TENANT IN ('1ee6b5b4fe8c45cfa16c3ecdbb8ee02b')) SELECT sswa.subnet_name, sswa.subnet_cidr, sswa.rbac_target_tenant, sswa.window_column, sdo.coefficient_of_variation FROM SharedSubnetWindowedAttrs AS sswa JOIN SubnetDNSOrderVariation AS sdo ON sswa.subnet_name = sdo.subnet_name WHERE sdo.coefficient_of_variation > 0 ORDER BY sdo.coefficient_of_variation DESC
